works.title: The Annunciation
works.rightsSummary: Met object marked Public Domain and included in Open Access
works.visualReview: The source image has a narrow brown support-edge border; do not certify frame-free until a conservative edge trim is inspected. Narrow 9:16 cover crops exclude parts of Mary's lectern and Gabriel/angel wings. Complete composition is essential.

works.title: The Coronation of the Virgin (oil sketch)
works.rightsSummary: Met object API marked Public Domain (CC0 policy)
works.visualReview: Narrow portrait cover crop discards outer red-and-gold figures/robes and peripheral cherubs. Source is an oil sketch and must be captioned as such. Preserve the full Trinitarian Coronation grouping.

works.title: The Holy Trinity
works.rightsSummary: Institutional collection lists image CC0; IIIF manifestation reports Public Domain Mark 1.0
works.visualReview: Portrait cover cuts flanking putti/angels and instruments of Passion. Father, slain Son and Holy Spirit must stay together; 9:16 center/high previews are not independent useful crop proposals. The master 19k original remains to be fetched separately.
